semantics.prediction: Combinational: history is current global history; taken is MSB of PHT[predict_pc XOR history]. Original says prediction uses state before next positive-edge training.
semantics.history_update: At positive edge, train_valid AND train_mispredicted has priority: append train_taken to train_history. Otherwise predict_valid appends pre-edge predict_taken to current history. Otherwise hold.
semantics.training: At positive edge when train_valid, increment/decrement PHT[train_pc XOR train_history] with saturation according to train_taken; independent of history update.
semantics.reset: Original explicitly requires asynchronous active-high reset. Assumed reset history=0 and all PHT counters=01. No specified power-up state; RTL remains unknown until reset.
semantics.invalid_prediction: Outputs remain combinational even when predict_valid=0; specification only requires valid predictions. Invalid requests never advance history.
semantics.timing: No added ports or latency. Shift toward MSB, newest branch in bit 0.

numeric.counter_encoding: 00 strongly not taken, 01 weakly not taken, 10 weakly taken, 11 strongly taken
numeric.history_truncation: retain lower six previous bits and append outcome

verification.oracle: Independent integer counters and arithmetic history update derived from original behavioral requirements; compare only valid prediction direction and always history.
verification.phases: Drive at falling edge; check before rising edge for old training state; update model from pre-edge prediction; check after rising-edge NBA settle.
coverage: asynchronous reset away from clock edge
verification.evaluator: python3 dev_check.py --label initial; fatal mismatches, bounded timeout, explicit PASS

specification_ambiguities.assumption: History zero; each counter weakly not taken (01).
